entries.title: At Hearth, the morning settles quiet over the familiar spread of stone and timber.
entries.text: At Hearth, the morning settles quiet over the familiar spread of stone and timber. Wren turns toward Ash, a question already half-formed — one about heading to the Market to check on the carts. "Heading to the Market to see about those carts?" Ash shifts, a decision made in the beat of a moment. "Aye, I'll come. Carts late means trouble — let's see it firsthand."

entries.title: The Market stretches ahead, stalls and awnings rustling in the morning air, as Wren quickens their pace toward Ash.
entries.text: The Market stretches ahead, stalls and awnings rustling in the morning air, as Wren quickens their pace toward Ash. "Ash, wait up — I meant the Market, and you're already moving. I'll walk with you." Wren steps forward, falling into step beside Ash as they both move through the Market.

entries.text: At the Market, things begin to shift. Wren moves. Ash moves.

entries.title: At the Market, the two figures shift position, neither fully committing to a path just yet.
entries.text: At the Market, the two figures shift position, neither fully committing to a path just yet. Wren makes a decisive move, stepping forward among the stalls. Ash mirrors the motion, closing the distance between them.

entries.title: The scene settles at the Market, where the constant hum of trade fills the air.
entries.text: The scene settles at the Market, where the constant hum of trade fills the air. Wren moves through the space, navigating the stalls and the crowd. Nearby, Ash remains still, watching and waiting.

entries.title: The scene shifts to the bustling Market, where the morning trade is already underway.
entries.text: The scene shifts to the bustling Market, where the morning trade is already underway. Wren makes a deliberate move, stepping through the crowd. From a short distance, Ash observes the unfolding scene carefully, taking in every detail.

entries.title: The Market stands before them, its carts absent from their usual spots.
entries.text: The Market stands before them, its carts absent from their usual spots. Wren moves, glancing over at the empty spaces where the carts should be. Wren turns to Ash and says, "Ash, you said you'd come with me to the Market — the carts are missing, and I don't want to go alone. We still going?" Ash waits in place, not yet answering.

entries.title: The scene opens at the bustling Market, carts and stalls stretching in every direction.
entries.text: The scene opens at the bustling Market, carts and stalls stretching in every direction. "Ash — we're still on for the Market? Carts won't check themselves," Wren calls out. Wren begins to move through the crowd, heading toward the stalls. Ash, however, holds back, waiting in place near the entrance. An audience member watches the exchange, noting the contrast between Wren's urgency and Ash's stillness.
